title: A pay that is late after a holiday weekend (review v3 situation 1, decision H8)
story: One bank in Japan. Pay of 250,000 on the 10th, moved to the working day before. Rent of 80,000 on the 27th, moved to the working day after. In January 2027 the 10th is a Sunday, so the pay should land Fri 8 Jan. Mon 11 Jan is a holiday. The pay really arrives Tue 12 Jan and the person logs it on Wed 13 Jan. Pay inside its posting window (one working day after it should land, so up to Tue 12 Jan) is late but still expected: it counts and the period does not move on (H8). After the window it is not seen yet and stops counting. Every amount is made up.

events.note: arrived Tue 12 Jan, logged the next morning

asks.question: days_to_next_pay
asks.why: the pay due Sun 10 Jan should have landed Fri 8 Jan and has not come yet; it may still post until Tue 12 Jan, so it is late and still expected, and the period does not move on
asks.note: The model before H8 said 32 days to 10 Feb.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 310,000 (bank today: 300,000 opening - 80,000 rent 27 Nov + 250,000 pay 10 Dec - 80,000 rent 28 Dec = 390,000; the late pay of 250,000 is not counted [BH1], so the lowest point is 27 Jan: 390,000 - 80,000 rent) = 310,000
asks.note: BH1 (replaces H8 for safe to spend): money not yet seen never counts. Under H8 the late pay counted today: 390,000.

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 80,000 (rent 27 Jan, before the pay after the late one, 10 Feb) = 80,000
asks.note: BH1: the late pay is not counted, so the list runs to the pay after it. Under H8 it ran to the late pay: none.

asks.question: days_to_next_pay
asks.why: Mon 11 Jan was a holiday, so Tue 12 Jan is the last day of the posting window: still late and expected

asks.question: not_seen_yet

why.money_in: 250,000 (pay, should have landed Fri 8 Jan, window over Tue 12 Jan) = 250,000

asks.note: Passes on the model before H8 too: after the window the reading did not change.

asks.question: days_to_next_pay
asks.note: Not seen yet, so it is no longer the next pay. Passes before H8 too.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.note: After the window the late pay stops counting (H8). Passes before H8 too.
